item.text: {"outcome":"pass","rationale":"The answer is concrete and supported by the preserved bundle. `command.go:1794–1803` explicitly says `Command.Flag` climbs the command tree, looks up the name via `c.Flags().Lookup(name)`, and falls back to `c.persistentFlag(name)`; therefore no manual `Parent()` traversal is required.
